dialogues.speaker: Drillbit Dance Dance-Off Announcement
dialogues.text: "The results of the 127751st Drillbit Dance daily dance-off have been announced! Itzna has won the crown, marking her 200th win in the daily dance-off!"

dialogues.speaker: Drillbit Dance Dance-Off Announcement
dialogues.text: "Children of Echoes, let's hear you make some noise! The next time we see Itzna, lift her onto your shoulders, throw her into the sky, and celebrate her success!"

dialogues.speaker: Drillbit Dance Dance-Off Announcement
dialogues.text: "In addition, Zacatula and Tlaco have now participated in the competition for 1200 and 1700 total days respectively! Give it up for our two old friends!"

dialogues.speaker: Drillbit Dance Dance-Off Announcement
dialogues.text: "And as for you youngsters watching the dancers from offstage, how can you still stay still?"

dialogues.speaker: Drillbit Dance Dance-Off Announcement
dialogues.text: "Get up on the stage, and dance, dance, dance! Become a member of the Drillbit Dance! Show us your courage and resolve, and you can also become a legend of the stage!"
